# Filip Rastovic

> Senior Shopify Developer and Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Belgrade, Serbia. 10+ years of professional web development experience. Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering.

## About

- Full name: Filip Rastovic (also written Filip Rastović / Филип Растовић)
- Role: Senior Shopify Developer and Full-Stack Software Engineer
- Location: Belgrade, Serbia (GMT+2)
- Experience: 10+ years of professional web development
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering
- Languages: English, Serbian
- Availability: Remote worldwide; accepting new projects for Q3 and Q4 of 2026
- Website: https://filiprastovic.com/
- Email contact: via https://filiprastovic.com/

## What Filip does

- Senior Shopify development: theme architecture, custom Shopify themes, Shopify Plus implementations, Liquid, custom sections and blocks, theme migrations.
- Headless Shopify: Hydrogen and Remix storefronts on top of the Shopify Storefront GraphQL API.
- Custom Shopify apps and integrations against the Shopify Admin GraphQL API.
- Full-stack web applications: PHP / Laravel, Node.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, SQL.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): A/B testing, landing page design, funnel analysis, performance optimization, UX/UI implementation from Figma.
- Data and tooling: Python / Pandas scripts for migrations, data cleanup, reporting, and internal tools.

## Tech stack

- Shopify: Liquid, Hydrogen, Remix, Storefront API, Admin API, Shopify Plus, Shopify Apps
- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: PHP, Laravel, Node.js, SQL (Postgres / MySQL), Python
- Design: Figma, Photoshop, Cinema 4D, Octane Render

## Selected clients and brands

Google, Johnson & Johnson, Cosy House Collection, Bare Home, Linjer, Hey Nutrition.

## Current work

- Independent contractor: Head of Web Development for an agency engagement (web development and CRO).
- Building: Lander.rs - an AI-assisted landing page builder for lead generation.

## Background

- Before specializing in Shopify and backend systems, Filip worked extensively in 3D art (Cinema 4D, Octane Render) from 2020-2023. The work received international press coverage and inbound interest from Google and Microsoft.
